text:
Maria (SRE): heads up — right after the 09:12 deploy I'm seeing a surge of 500s from the new /v2/generate route on canary. Good chunk of traffic hitting canary nodes. Dashboard for that route is missing (I can't find per-route latency/5xx panel). :rotating_light:
incidents-bot: Alert PAGER-482 created for service: inference-api - high-error-rate on target: /v2/generate - severity: page
Devon (Backend): on it. I see the deploy-bot shows canary rollout at 80%. Any recent config/flag changes?
deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-04-05T09:12 by devon - canary=80% - feature_flag: new-gen-path=on - autoscale: default
Maria (SRE): we didn't add explicit dashboards for the new path in the rollout docs. Need metrics: requests/latency/5xx by route. Prom query I ran returned too-aggregate results.
Sam (Oncall): I'm taking the pager. Sam -> Maria for handoff. Sam: can you paste the top noisy errors?
Maria (SRE): logs show this pattern from canary pods:
```
ERROR inference: request handler failed: KeyError 'context_tokens'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/handlers/generate.py", line 213, in handle_request
    context = payload['context_tokens']
KeyError: 'context_tokens'
```
Maria (SRE): looks like the model input contract changed; new client path may be sending old payload. 5xxs are legit.
Devon (Backend): ack. That KeyError is from a validation layer I pushed yesterday to tighten input shape. I thought it was safe behind flag. Looks like flag wiring might be inverted for canary.
Lee (Product): any customer impact metrics? Are we seeing 10% of requests failing or more?
Maria (SRE): on canary hosts failure rate ~45% for /v2/generate from 09:13-09:21. Global traffic hitting canary is ~7% so user-visible errors ~3% sample of total traffic. Need quick mitigation.
Sam (Oncall): proposed mitigations: 1) kill feature flag to stop routing to new handler 2) rollback canary 3) patch validation in place. Which is fastest?
Devon (Backend): killing flag should revert to old handler immediately if flag gate is respected. But if wiring inverted it may not. Rollback is safer immediate option.
Maria (SRE): we also don't have the per-route dashboard panels in the deploy playbook for this route — that's why triage was slower. Can we add a temporary dashboard? I'm short on time to build panels now.
Sam (Oncall): I'll do rollback then. Command I'll run: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=2026-04-05-09-05` — will notify when started.
Devon (Backend): I'll prepare a quick kill-flag patch as follow-up, but rollback first. Also adding a quick Prom alert: `increase(http_requests_total{route="/v2/generate",status=~"5.."}[5m]) > 5` to catch post-rollback regressions.
incidents-bot: Action logged — rollback started by Sam at 09:18 UTC. Pager state: acknowledged.
Sam (Oncall): rollback in progress, pods terminating and new pods at previous revision coming up. Monitoring pod logs.
Maria (SRE): confirming 5xx rate dropping on canary IPs — looks like rollback is reducing errors.
Devon (Backend): I see old pods back up. Can we keep canary at 0% while we validate the flag wiring?
Sam (Oncall): setting canary weight to 0% via routing console now. `routectl set-weight inference-api canary 0` -> done.
Lee (Product): good. I'll draft a short customer note if this impacts customer SLAs. Do we know which tenants hit the new path?
Maria (SRE): quick query shows spikes from tenant ids: tenant_42, tenant_87, tenant_experiment. I'll hand this to success for customer outreach.
Devon (Backend): root cause: validation change + flag gating bug. I'll open PR to revert the validation + add stronger backend guards to default to safe parsing. Also will add unit test for missing keys.
Sam (Oncall): timeline for fix?
Devon (Backend): hotfix PR in ~40m, deploy to staging for smoke in 10m after CI.
Maria (SRE): follow-ups: 1) add per-route panels to deploy playbook 2) add canary-specific SLO visibility (token-level) 3) postmortem capturing why flag wiring wasn't tested against canary weight changes.
incidents-bot: Incident PAGER-482 marked as mitigated at 09:26 UTC (cause: rollback to previous canary revision). Follow-up task created: TASK-998 - "add per-route dashboards + canary SLO visibility" assigned to Maria and Devon.
Sam (Oncall): closing the page. If anyone sees a regression ping me directly.
Lee (Product): thanks all. I'll coordinate customer comms with success and postmortem once Devon/Maria have notes. :white_check_mark:
Devon (Backend): pushing a small checklist to the PR description to avoid missing routing/flag interactions in future rollouts.
Maria (SRE): noted — adding observability checklist to deploy runbook now.
Sam (Oncall): handing back to oncall rotation — I updated the incident channel with summary. Good job team.
